params.prompt:
45-second comic book storyboard sheet for an educational short film. A professional storyboard presentation page featuring 9 sequential cinematic panels in a clean grid of 3 columns and 3 rows, every panel a tall vertical 9:16 frame for a phone screen, read left to right, top to bottom.

Style: dramatic modern 2D animated superhero film, matching the first attached image: huge solid black shadow masses, hard graphic cut between light and shadow, no gradients, very few contour lines, flat saturated colour on the lit side only, one violent coloured light source per panel, one dominant colour per panel. The second attached image carries rendering only, never its character. The world, the objects and the places are the stars of this film; the hero of the first attached image appears only in panels 4, 7 and 9, and only partially in 4 and 7.

The upper third of every panel stays calm for on-screen titles added later. No people's faces are ever shown except the hero's in panel 9; no victims, no blood, no violence shown.

Storyboard layout: off-white production storyboard paper, thin black frame borders, each panel numbered with a small number above it and one short handwritten-style note below it. No other text inside the panels.

Panel 1. Bird's-eye view of a dense night city drawn like a tactical blueprint in electric blue lines; thin precise targeting lines converge on one single building while all the others stay untouched.
Panel 2. A long wall covered with dozens of missing-person posters, each showing only a blank silhouette, under a cold streetlight; deep red dominant light.
Panel 3. Cutaway cross-section like a comic infographic: a school building on the surface, beneath it a network of tunnels holding rocket launchers; toxic green light underground.
Panel 4. Close-up of the hero's gloved hand (navy and light blue glove) holding up a large chart whose line rises steeply upward; only the hand and forearm of the hero are visible.
Panel 5. Night sky over a city filled with dozens of rocket trails and bright interception bursts; burning orange dominant.
Panel 6. Exactly the same framing as panel 5 but the sky is empty and calm at dawn, soft pale blue, a single bird.
Panel 7. A door opening onto bright light; silhouettes seen from behind walking out toward the light; in the dark foreground, the edge of the hero's navy cape and his shoulder, seen from behind.
Panel 8. An old worn document lying on a dark desk under a single hard lamp beam, its writing unreadable abstract lines, ominous violet shadows.
Panel 9. Heroic comic book cover composition: the hero, full body, reaches up and turns off an old hanging gas lamp, the flame going out; strong magenta rim light, deep ultramarine background, the upper half kept open for a big title.

Art direction: consistent rendering across all panels, varied camera angles, strong vertical compositions. No text, no letters, no logos anywhere inside the panels.

input.context: Storyboard sheet for the CAM attack video, to be validated before key images and animation.
